const it = Iterator.from({
  next(): IteratorResult<number, undefined> {
    return { done: true, value: undefined };
  },
});
console.log(it.toArray());
abstract class Base extends Iterator<number> {}
class Numbers extends Base {
  #count = 0;
  next(): IteratorResult<number, undefined> {
    this.#count += 1;
    return this.#count > 3 ? { done: true, value: undefined } : { done: false, value: this.#count };
  }
}
const n: Iterator<number> = new Numbers();
console.log(n.next(), new Numbers().map((x) => x * 2).toArray());
let ctor: IteratorConstructor = Iterator;
console.log(typeof ctor);
